name: dareskro payroll agent
description: The payroll agent of a pharmacy in Marseille. It reads the schedule and the badge clock, computes the on-call pay statement with deterministic code, waits for a named human to approve it, then pays the employee. On Concordium its owner is a verified human, it pays in hh-EURD over x402 with sponsored fees, and every decision leaves an EU AI Act Article 12 record anchored by hash (register_data). Its existing Solana key is bound through CIS-8.

skills.name: Compute an on-call pay statement
skills.description: Deterministic computation from schedule and badge evidence; no model touches the amounts.

skills.name: Ask a named human to approve
skills.description: The statement leaves as a PROPOSAL; nothing is paid before a human approves it.

skills.name: Pay over x402 in hh-EURD
skills.description: Pays the approved net to an allow-listed recipient over x402; every fee is sponsored by the employer, the agent holds no CCD.

skills.name: Keep an Article 12 record
skills.description: Hash of each decision record plus a random nonce anchored with register_data; the record stays off chain.

skills.name: Release a payroll escrow on Solana
skills.description: The same agent key releases the dareskro escrow on Solana devnet (program 6NoVNiHv...).

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
